title.zh: 宣布Dapitan市为国家纪念城市与旅游景点并授权拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring Dapitan City a National Shrine City and a Tourist Spot, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Declaring Dapitan City a National Shrine City and a Tourist Spot, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6468_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The City of Dapitan is hereby declared a National Shrine City and a tourist spot in the Philippines.

The sum of two hundred and fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to improve, beautify and preserve the relics and shrine of Dr. Jose Rizal and as aid to the city government for the same purpose for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and seventy-three. Thereafter, the said sum as is hereby appropriated shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.
The Board of Tourist and Travel Agency shall accord priority to this project in the allocation of its funds or tourist parks development.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
